## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`pnpm test` passes locally)
- [ ] Transformer or normaliser change: an input fixture under `tests/fixtures/` and the expected output in a test
- [ ] Security-relevant change (sanitizer, media checks, download guard, archives, dumps, reports): a hacked-site case that shows the attack is stopped
- [ ] New dependency: one line on why it is needed and why the standard library is not enough
- [ ] New or changed report code: `docs/reference/codes.md` updated
- [ ] User-facing change: a line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, and the README or `docs/` updated
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, with single-line subjects
